name: sgl
source: Wu et al., Self-supervised Graph Learning for Recommendation, SIGIR 2021 (SGL-ED); github.com/wujcan/SGL-Torch @ c563288 (model/general_recommender/SGL.py, conf/SGL.ini)
grid_source: Paper Sec. 4.1.2: lambda1 (ssl_reg) in {0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0}, tau (ssl_temp) in {0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0}, rho (ssl_ratio) in {0, 0.1, ..., 0.5} (240 points). Repository defaults (0.1, 0.2, 0.1) are one grid point. 8-trial budget: ssl_reg {0.05, 0.1} x ssl_temp {0.2, 0.5} x ssl_ratio {0.1, 0.2}: the neighbourhood of the defaults, which the paper reports as its best region; our choice.
memory: plain LightGCN plus two edge-dropped sparse graphs and two batch x n_users / n_items similarity matrices (2048 x 91k floats = 0.75 GB on Amazon-Book); three propagations per batch, so about 3 to 4 times the time of Plain-BPR
